title: Chicken and White Bean Panzanella with Rocket
changes_from_base: Chicken is baked on top of the bread cubes in one pan, cannellini beans and rocket bulk out the salad, and the dressing is sharpened with cider vinegar.
summary: A main-course bread salad: juicy tomatoes, cannellini beans and red onion dressed in olive oil and cider vinegar, tossed with crisp oven-toasted bread, chunks of chicken and peppery rocket.

ingredients.item: day-old country bread or baguette, cut into 2 cm cubes
fine sea salt or table salt
fine sea salt or table salt
canned cannellini beans, drained and rinsed (one 400 g tin)

steps.title: Dress the tomatoes
steps.text: Heat the oven to 230 °C (210 °C fan). Whisk the oil, vinegar and salt in the bowl, stir in the tomatoes with their juice, beans, onion and basil, and set aside.

steps.title: Brown the chicken
steps.text: Season the chicken with half the salt and the pepper. Brown in the oiled pan over medium-high heat, 2 min a side, then lift out.

steps.title: Bake on the bread
steps.text: Toss the bread with the oil and remaining salt, spread in the pan, sit the chicken on top and bake 12-15 min until the chicken reads 74 °C and the bread is crisp in spots.

steps.title: Fold and rest
steps.text: Cut the chicken into chunks and fold it, the bread and the rocket into the tomatoes. Top with shaved cheese and rest 5-10 min before serving.

tips: Bake the bread under the chicken so it soaks up the juices and crisps.
Use the ripest tomatoes and keep all their juice.
Rest 5-10 min so the bread softens at the edges.
storage: Best eaten on the day. Keep any leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 1 day. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
